usage: sot-validator discover [-h] [--cidr CIDR] [--site-id SITE_ID] [--site-name SITE_NAME]
                              [--output OUTPUT] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                              [--snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR]
                              [--gateway-octets GATEWAY_OCTETS [GATEWAY_OCTETS ...]]
                              [--tcp-ports TCP_PORTS [TCP_PORTS ...]]
                              [--max-concurrency MAX_CONCURRENCY]
                              [--max-active-subnets MAX_ACTIVE_SUBNETS]
                              [--ping-timeout PING_TIMEOUT] [--tcp-timeout TCP_TIMEOUT]
                              [--mock-config MOCK_CONFIG] [--fixtures] [--router-arp ROUTER_ARP]
                              [--dhcp-leases DHCP_LEASES] [--proxmox-snapshot PROXMOX_SNAPSHOT]
                              [--evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME] [--validate] [--report]
                              [--html-dashboard] [--html-output HTML_OUTPUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cidr CIDR           Target IPv4 /16 or /24 CIDR block to discover (default: 10.42.0.0/16).
  --site-id SITE_ID     Identifier for the generated Site snapshot (default: site-discovered).
  --site-name SITE_NAME
                        Human-readable name for the generated Site snapshot (default: Discovered
                        Site).
  --output, --output-file OUTPUT
                        Optional output file path for the discovered Site JSON snapshot.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Optional directory to write discovered_site.json, validation_results.json,
                        and reports.
  --snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR
                        Optional SnapshotStore directory to persist the discovered Site.
  --gateway-octets GATEWAY_OCTETS [GATEWAY_OCTETS ...]
                        Gateway host fourth octets to probe during /16 Stage 1 discovery (default:
                        1).
  --tcp-ports TCP_PORTS [TCP_PORTS ...]
                        TCP ports to probe on discovered hosts.
  --max-concurrency MAX_CONCURRENCY
                        Maximum concurrent async network probes (default: 128).
  --max-active-subnets MAX_ACTIVE_SUBNETS
                        Maximum active /24 subnets to sweep within a /16 (default: 32).
  --ping-timeout PING_TIMEOUT
                        ICMP ping timeout in seconds (default: 1.0).
  --tcp-timeout TCP_TIMEOUT
                        TCP connect probe timeout in seconds (default: 0.35).
  --mock-config, --fixture-config, --discovery-fixture MOCK_CONFIG
                        Optional JSON file providing mock ping/TCP/ARP/rDNS callbacks or pre-
                        discovered hosts.
  --fixtures            Use deterministic offline discovery callbacks without live network
                        traffic.
  --router-arp ROUTER_ARP
                        Optional router ARP table file (JSON records or ExtremeXOS/VOSS/ip-neigh
                        CLI text) to enrich discovered hosts.
  --dhcp-leases DHCP_LEASES
                        Optional DHCP lease export file (JSON, ISC, CSV, or dnsmasq) to enrich
                        discovered hosts.
  --proxmox-snapshot PROXMOX_SNAPSHOT
                        Optional Proxmox/Portainer snapshot JSON used to fill missing guest
                        hostnames and MACs.
  --evaluation-time, --observed-at EVALUATION_TIME
                        Optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for discovery observation and
                        classification.
  --validate            Also run ClassificationEngine on the discovered Site snapshot.
  --report              Also generate JSON, CSV, and Markdown validation reports.
  --html-dashboard      Also generate self-contained interactive HTML5 validation dashboard.
  --html-output HTML_OUTPUT
                        Optional custom output path for the HTML5 validation dashboard.
